headline: New skill — stalled-projects: surface projects that have gone quiet

items.prompt_template: New skill — stalled-projects. Surfaces every project that has gone quiet (no meetings, commitments, decisions, or real conversations within a threshold you set: 14 days for active, 30 for exploring, 60 for dormant — all configurable on first fire). Fire it with 'show me stalled projects' or 'what's stalled'. Projects you created but never touched also surface, with a different recommended action. In an upcoming release this will also surface automatically in Pulse + Friday Wrap.
